messages:
jordan: Heads-up — telemetry trending: v1 error rate up for long sequences (>2000 tokens). Proposal: Console "soft-hide" v1 from new route creation for tenants while keeping existing pinned routes. Want quick feedback.

leah: ok, makes sense as a progressive deprec pattern. We need a clear per-route risk panel so customers see seq length distribution + error heatmap before hiding.

pranav: infra flag: if many tenants flip, v2 capacity could get hit. Can Console show an estimated capacity/quota delta when tenant enables soft-hide?

jordan: rough plan: add a tenant-scoped toggle "Hide legacy runtime (v1) for new routes" that when enabled does: 
- start sampled compatibility probes (default 1%) mirroring requests to v2 to collect error/latency/quality deltas
- remove v1 option from "create route" dropdown (existing pinned routes remain)
- surface a heatmap and an "estimated cost/latency impact" card
- offer a one-click bulk unpin assist (requires explicit opt-in)

sam: two red flags: probes increasing billed usage, and surprise auto-migration => support churn. Suggest probes be non-billable by default and require tenant opt-in for any auto-unpin/auto-migrate. Also add probe rate caps.

jordan: agreed on opt-in. Implementation idea: mirror probes carry a "probe" tag and are routed to a non-billable probe_bucket. Feature flags: feature.console.soft_hide.probe_bucket=true.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: staged feature flag created: feature.console.soft_hide -> targeting canary, staging-1

pranav: probe traffic still affects capacity planning. We should emit an internal metric probe_volume per-tenant that drives autoscaling but does not increment billing counters.

leah: UI copy draft: "Hide legacy v1 from new route creation (existing pinned routes unaffected). Run compatibility probes to estimate migration risk. Probes are sampled and do not count toward billing by default." Add inline tooltip: "Probes are sampled requests routed to an internal probe bucket; we emit capacity metrics but do not bill these tokens."

jordan: alerting policy suggestion: if probe fail-rate delta > 5% OR perplexity drift > 10% vs baseline -> auto-pause soft-hide and create ops alert.

sam: add autoscaling guard: if probe suggests >10% tenant traffic would shift and v2 cluster usage would exceed 70%, pause auto-unpin and surface a capacity reservation recommendation to tenant.

jordan: runbook steps: disable flag, set probe_rate=0, notify tenants, rollback auto-unpins. I'll include that in the PR along with wireframes and backend contract:
```
feature.console.soft_hide.enabled = boolean
feature.console.soft_hide.probe_rate = 0.01
feature.console.soft_hide.probe_bucket = boolean
feature.console.soft_hide.auto_unpin_optin = boolean
```

pranav: please add a revert step that also clears any probe tags in metrics aggregation to avoid polluting historical billing views.

leah: also add a small telemetry widget exposing per-route expected token delta so CS can pre-warn big spenders.

jordan: will do. Opening PR and will tag @pranav @leah @sam for review. :thumbsup:
